start: Messages & offers, signed in as owner; the gym has members with and without the app

steps.action: Open Messages & offers and go to 'Who gets it'
user_sees: A 'Group' list: Everyone, Plan running today, Plans ending within 7 days, Plans ended in the last 30 days, Stopped coming, Birthdays today, On one plan, In one batch
must_not: A group missing
Archived members counted in any group

steps.action: Pick 'Plans ending within 7 days'
user_sees: 'In the app: N members of this group. Not in the app: N.'
A member whose last day is today is in the group
must_not: A member who already ended yesterday in this group
The two numbers not adding up to the group

steps.action: Look at 'Send on WhatsApp to'
user_sees: Two choices with counts: 'Not in the app' and 'Whole group'
must_not: 'Not in the app' includes someone who has the app
A count that differs from the list sent

steps.action: Tap 'Send in the app' (demo gym only when testing)
user_sees: Only the members of the picked group who have the app get it
must_not: Every app member gets a message meant for a small group
A member outside the group gets it

start: Messages & offers, Who gets it, signed in as owner

steps.action: Pick 'Birthdays today' on a day with no birthday
user_sees: A plain line that nobody is in this group today, and nothing can be sent to nobody
must_not: A send button that sends to everyone instead
A count of 0 with a working send

steps.action: Pick a group where nobody has the app
user_sees: 'Nobody in this group has the MettleUp app yet. Send it on WhatsApp.'
must_not: 'In the app: 0 members' with an app send still offered

steps.action: Pick 'On one plan' in a gym with no plans on sale
user_sees: The group falls back to 'Everyone' (for a ready message) or the Plan list is empty and the group has nobody
must_not: A crash
Personal-training packs offered as plans

steps.action: Pick 'In one batch' and no batch
user_sees: Nobody in the group until a batch is picked
must_not: Everyone treated as in the batch

start: Messages & offers, Who gets it, signed in as owner

steps.action: Pick 'Plans ended in the last 30 days', note the count, then renew one of those members and come back
user_sees: The count is one lower; the member is now in Plan running today
must_not: The renewed member still gets the ended-plan message

steps.action: Pick 'Stopped coming', check one of them in on Attendance, come back
user_sees: That member has left the group
must_not: A member who came today still gets the message

steps.action: Switch from 'In one batch' to 'Everyone' and back
user_sees: 'Everyone (N)' counts every person once: list members plus app members not on the list
The batch picked before is still picked or is asked again
must_not: A person counted twice in Everyone
The old group still used for the send

start: Messages & offers, signed in as owner; other kinds: 'On one plan' and 'In one batch'

steps.action: Pick 'On one plan'
user_sees: A 'Plan' list of the gym plans on sale in the sell order; a ready message starts on the one-month plan
must_not: A plan no longer sold listed
A member whose plan of that kind has ended counted

steps.action: Pick 'In one batch'
user_sees: A 'Batch' list of the batches that members who are not archived carry
must_not: The same batch twice in two spellings
A batch only archived members carry

steps.action: Pick 'Stopped coming'
user_sees: The same people as the Losing the habit list on Attendance
must_not: A different count from Attendance on the same day

start: Messages & offers, Who gets it, signed in as owner

steps.action: Pick a small group and read the counts
user_sees: Counts only; the member app is matched by the 10 digits of the mobile number
must_not: A member matched to another person through a badly typed number
An app member of another gym counted

steps.action: Send in the app to the small group (demo gym only when testing)
user_sees: Only that group reads it in the app
must_not: The message visible to every member of the gym
Members without the app counted as reached

start: Any page, signed in as front desk

steps.action: Look for Messages & offers in the menu
user_sees: It is not there; only the workout offer list and Automatic reminders are open to the desk
must_not: A greyed-out entry
The group picker shown to the desk

steps.action: Open the workout offer list from its own link
user_sees: The offer list, with no way to write a message to a group
must_not: A send button for the desk

start: The browser address bar, signed in as front desk

steps.action: Type the address of Messages & offers
user_sees: The desk is sent to another page (the old link goes to Shop); no group picker
must_not: The Who gets it section opens
A blank page

start: Signed in as front desk, then the owner signs in on the same browser

steps.action: As desk, try the address again after a reload
user_sees: Still refused
must_not: The page opens after a reload

steps.action: Sign out, the owner signs in
user_sees: Messages & offers is in the menu with the group picker
must_not: The desk refusal sticks for the owner

steps.action: Try to send a message to members by any page the desk can open
user_sees: No such control; the server sends messages only for the owner
must_not: A desk login sends a message to members
The desk sees the count of app members of a group
